_comment: Development seed, committed on purpose. The real file is written by
scripts/publish-github-pages.mjs into out/artifacts/ during a publish, which
OVERWRITES this one -- next build copies public/ into out/ first, the publish
script writes second. So production never serves this.
It exists because without it the footer's ReleaseStamp fetched a 404 on
next dev, rendered null, and said nothing about it. Local and production
disagreed and neither surface admitted it. release_number 0 makes the
component render 'release dev', so the stamp is visible and styleable
locally and a missing/failed publish shows up as the word 'dev' in a place
